scope: Frozen P19 R4 checker/evidence-boundary diagnostic only. Not full candidate acceptance. Canonical codec/universal-proof defects are out of scope because root already sealed them for R5.

findings.title: RunFixtures check mode overwrites outstanding from the filename substring F43
findings.classification: checker bug. Selecting a test case by name is valid. Changing the report from that name is not valid checker evidence.

raw_mode_control.note: rawExecute ignores filename. F43_in.json raw stdout equals neutral raw stdout.

checkBytes_control.note: Check.lean never writes sourceRefinement into outstanding. checkTyped outstanding is only libraries/invariants. source_map is unread. sourceRefinement judgment is tautologically notApplicable.

findings.python_runner: scripts/run_certificate_fixtures.py has no F43 semantic branch. It names the temp file {id}_in.json, which is enough to fire the Lean substring oracle.
smallest_repair: Delete RunFixtures.lean lines 38-41. check mode must print checkBytes/encodeReport unchanged.
Do not restore the obligation by filename, fixture id, or path substring.
See P19-EB-02 for the reviewed input/expectation overlay that keeps S57.

findings.title: F25 and F43 are identical documents with conflicting expected outstanding
findings.classification: Separate a planning ambiguity from the checker bug. The checker bug is P19-EB-01. The planning defect is that S57 was bound to a duplicate of the F25 payload, then made green by the filename oracle.
do_not: Do not keep the filename oracle.
Do not silently delete S57 or F43.
Do not rewrite frozen original bytes in place.

proposed_reviewed_correction.preserve_frozen_bytes: Keep the original 147d3f95... payload as historical F25/F43 inputs.
proposed_reviewed_correction.recommended: Make outstanding sourceRefinement a document-derived checkIR fact: nonempty source_map records outstanding sourceRefinement. Then identical bytes yield identical reports. Overlay F25 expected outstanding to [sourceRefinement]. Keep F43 expected. S57 remains. F25 still witnesses transfer-three success (accepted, alice 7, bob 3). PB04 is about the pin, which both documents already contain.
proposed_reviewed_correction.alternative: Reviewed F43 overlay adds an explicit envelope flag such as require_source_refinement_outstanding=true, leaving F25 expected outstanding=[]. Frozen original F43 bytes stay as a historical duplicate. New F43 bytes must differ by that reviewed field, not by filename.
proposed_reviewed_correction.why_recommended: F25 already carries the Examples.lean source_map. Treating that pin as not-outstanding on F25 and outstanding on F43 is the planning contradiction the oracle was hiding.

findings.title: F13 decode IR field is a filename-injected label, not decoded-IR equality
findings.classification: evidence misclass. Decode success and raw_utf8 echo can still be real. The ir string is not whole-IR equality.

source.note: match decodeBytes .ok _ discards the IR. irVal is the literal DecodedIR of F25 payload iff path.contains F13, else JSON null.

reproduction.encodeCodecResult_would_emit: ir object {} on ok, never the F13 literal

findings.canonical_order_note: Root already recorded R4-CANONICAL-FIXTURE-CONFLICT on these F13 bytes (source_map transfer before store). This diagnostic does not rediscover that codec defect. It only classifies the ir label.
smallest_repair: On decode ok, either omit ir, emit a boolean decoded=true, or encode the actual IR.
Do not claim S13/S14 as whole-IR equality from this label.
Keep S14 envelope-keys-present as decode-ok plus raw echo if that is the reviewed evidence class.

findings.title: checkAudit grants passed from untrusted document fields; F44/S58 is not per-certificate compiler evidence
findings.classification: Lower-level untrusted summary plus a missing host bind. Not a demand that pure Lean do filesystem IO. The accepted contract requires the actual driver to bind path/hash, successful compile, nonempty inventory, and compiler identity before passed.

contract.accepted_planning_interpretation_1: recorded compiler-discharge predicates require actual matching candidate/compiler/audit records, with path/hash identity, successful compiler execution and nonempty relevant inventory. Caller metadata alone never discharges an obligation.
contract.PB05_S58: WHEN implementation later runs the three #audit_axioms commands THEN each prefix reports a nonempty imported theorem inventory or is blocked.
contract.SF10: checkIR does not treat audit decode as an execution Report. Routing by mode is intended. Granting AuditResult.passed is a separate evidence act.

production_entrypoint.behavior: imported_theorems==0 -> blocked emptyScope; nonempty forbidden_claimed_roots -> passed claimed_covered=false; else extract prefixes from commands/auditPrefix/default DefiKernel and return passed. imported_theorems_min is decoded and unused. No IO. No compiler.

reproduction.case: F44 check stdout fed to parse_and_validate_audit

global_control_not_per_certificate.note: Useful campaign-level host control. Python requires it for process exit. Fixture F44/F45/F46 are still marked passed from checkAudit JSON match even if this scan is considered separately. It does not authenticate an untrusted audit envelope.

trusted_host_boundary.untrusted: DecodedAudit fields and checkAudit/AuditResult derived from them.
trusted_host_boundary.trusted: Host driver that compiles the exact candidate, runs the three #audit_axioms commands, binds executable identity and source hashes, rejects empty/missing/failed scopes, then writes the per-certificate audit result.
trusted_host_boundary.R4_python_parser_controls: Five synthetic-string controls prove parse_and_validate_audit is not vacuous. They are not Lean checkAudit tests and not per-envelope compiler admission.

smallest_repair: Keep checkAudit as an untrusted document summary. Do not treat AuditResult.passed as compiler evidence.

For S58/F44, the driver must bind Verify.lean (or equivalent exact-candidate compile) before recording passed: requested path/hash, exit 0, nonempty actual scopes, compiler identity, coupled to that certificate.
Do not grant passed on caller-supplied imported_theorems>0, commands strings, or compiler_record objects.
imported_theorems_min must be enforced against actual inventory if it remains in the envelope.

findings.scope: F45 list inspection vs F46 empty-scope control
findings.title: F45 can be a declared-root list inspection; F46 blocks a claimed zero, not an observed empty compiler scope
findings.classification: Do not overclaim a vulnerability in a deliberately lower-level summary. Reclassify the evidence. S59 inspects the increment audit-root list. S60 requires an audit command that would observe zero imported theorems.

F45.spec_S59: WHEN this increment's audit-root list is inspected THEN it does not include unimported Nary/Claims/Arithmetic as covered roots.
F45.checkAudit: nonempty forbidden list => passed claimed_covered=false. This is self-attested non-claim, not a compiler observation of imports.
F45.honest_class: declared-root list inspection. Valid only if the host also checks the candidate's actual claimed roots against that list.
F45.invalid_class: compiler evidence that Nary was not imported.

F46.spec_S60: WHEN an audit command would observe zero imported theorems THEN blocked, never 0 of 0 pass.
F46.checkAudit: blocks on the supplied count 0. A supplied count 1 or 999 passes without compile.
F46.python_parser_empty_scope_control: does reject 0/0 in Verify.lean logs. That is the global scan, not F46.

smallest_repair: Label F45 as list-inspection. Host-check actual audit_roots / #audit_axioms prefixes against the forbidden set.
Make S60/F46 observe actual compiler inventory. A document field imported_theorems=0 is a negative control of checkAudit only.

findings.title: R4 14-field comparator, five parser controls, and theorem map do not prove the reported 99-verified scope

overclaims.actual: status counts are 87 verified_by_fixture, 11 verified_by_fixture_and_theorem, 1 bounded_fixture_verified. The summary counts any status containing the substring verified, so the open P20 row is included in 99.
S03 is Zero denominator is refused (F05). reportEq_refl is Report reflexivity. Unrelated.
S04 is JSON float amount is refused (F04). worldEq_refl is World reflexivity. Unrelated.
S82 is Kernel success is not Report.accepted. checkTyped_execute_ok concludes status=accepted under extra policy premises. The mapping credits the opposite slogan.
F43 outstanding is the P19-EB-01 filename oracle. Not checkBytes.
Document-derived checkAudit. Global Verify.lean is a separate campaign control.
Comparator walks expected keys only. Extra actual keys still match. Altered-value controls prove the comparator is not always-true. They do not prove the actual came from checkBytes.
Synthetic strings into parse_and_validate_audit. They discriminate the log parser. They do not authenticate F44-F46 envelopes.

theorems_that_can_remain_supporting: S41 rawExecute_typed_ok / checkTyped_execute_ok as accepted-path correspondence, not as S82
smallest_repair: Count statuses exactly. Do not substring-match verified.
Map theorems only to scenarios they state.
Keep S78 as open_for_p20 / bounded fixture, not inside a 99-verified headline.
